market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $95 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI $101-102 on May 4; intraday low already $99.21. Hitting $95 low requires only ~3% drop within 27 remaining days — well within typical monthly range, especially with high volatility around Iran ceasefire news.
assessment.key_uncertainty: If Iran tensions re-escalate, prices could stay elevated
